releases.body:
Faster Answers, No More "Hung" Chats

Speed is a feature. This release shaves real time off every single interaction — the first message in a new chat, every tool round in an agent loop, and the worst case that used to make chats *look* dead for minutes.

## The Problem: Chats That Felt Hung

After a tool call (a file read, a build, a todo update), Cursor sometimes goes completely silent — no text, no reasoning, no error — for minutes on end. The proxy's stall watchdog gave post-tool resumes the same 180-second budget as a cold first message, so a genuinely stuck stream kept the session "running" for a full **3 minutes** before recovery kicked in. One live session sat silent for **186 seconds** after a `todowrite` call before the watchdog restarted the stream and the agent finished the task.

## What's New

The stall budget is now **phase-aware down to the tool loop**:

| Generation Phase | Budget (v2.1) | Budget (v2.2) |
|---|---|---|
| Cold start, model thinking before first token | 180s | 180s (unchanged — thinking is work) |
| **Post-tool resume, no output yet** | 180s | **90s** |
| Reasoning flowing | configurable | configurable |
| Visible text paused | 45s | 45s |

A model that called a tool seconds ago is *working or stuck* — a 90-second silence now triggers the verified-safe checkpoint rebuild, cutting the worst-case "hang" in half.

Plus three more wins shaved off everywhere:

- **H2 pre-connect** — bridge workers establish their TLS/HTTP-2 connection to Cursor at startup instead of on your first request: the first message after a restart no longer pays the handshake.
- **Tool-call debounce 500ms → 250ms** — OpenCode can only start executing tools once the stream closes; every tool round in an agent loop is now a quarter-second quicker.
- **Title-gen model persisted to disk** — the ~2.5s Zen model probe no longer runs after every restart: titles resolve instantly from cache.

## Measured

- First message in a fresh chat, `gpt-5.4-nano`: **8.5s → 4.8s** (−44%)
- First message, `cursor/default` (auto-routed): **6.1s → 3.7s** (−39%)
- Follow-up turns (no tools): **2.4s**
- A 3-step file task with tool calls: **6.4s, zero stalls**

## Operational Notes

- New knob: `OPENCODE_CURSOR_POST_TOOL_PRE_OUTPUT_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS` (default 90s) — read dynamically at runtime.
- `OPENCODE_CURSOR_TOOL_DEBOUNCE_MS` (default 250ms) and `OPENCODE_CURSOR_TITLE_GEN_CACHE_PATH` give operators full control.
- The 180s cold-start budget is untouched: slow reasoning models are never interrupted mid-thought.

## Quality Assurance

38 smoke tests pass, including a new regression test that simulates a completely silent tool resume and proves the watchdog fires within the post-tool budget — plus hardened tests that eliminate a flaky keepalive-socket race in CI.

Upgrade, and feel the difference on the very first message.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/otto-assistant/opencode-cursor/compare/v2.1.0...v2.2.0

# v2.1.0 — Faster Responses: Eliminating the #1 Source of Latency

Every response should arrive as quickly as your model can produce it. Until now, slow "reasoning-class" models were paying a hidden double penalty — and we've fixed it at the root.

## The Problem

The proxy's stall watchdog declared a stream "stalled" after **45 seconds of silence**. But high-end reasoning models — such as `cursor/default`, which auto-routes to Cursor's opus-class backends — routinely **think for 60–120 seconds before emitting their first token**. The result: the watchdog discarded the model's completed reasoning, re-ran the entire request from scratch, and the user saw **doubled latency** — a 75-second answer for what should have taken ~45 seconds.

## What's New

The stall budget is now **phase-aware**, so the proxy never interrupts a model that is genuinely working:

| Generation Phase | Budget | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Model thinking (no output yet) | **180s** | Reasoning is work — never discard it |
| Reasoning stream flowing | Configurable | Wait calmly for the answer |
| Visible text flowing, then paused | 45s | A genuine stall finishes fast, not silently |

**The outcome:** responses from slow reasoning models are **no longer doubled by spurious restarts**. Verified live: a simple greeting on `cursor/default` now returns in **~13 seconds** instead of 45–75s.

## Operational Notes

- New tuning knob: `OPENCODE_CURSOR_PRE_OUTPUT_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS` (default 180s) — read dynamically, adjustable at runtime.
- Recovery limits now honor `MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES`.
- `proxyTelemetry` is exported for observability and testing.

## Quality Assurance

37 smoke tests pass, including a new regression test proving a silent "thinking" start does not trip the watchdog. Live latency measurements confirm the improvement.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/otto-assistant/opencode-cursor/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0

# v2.0.0 — The Root-Cause Release: A Loop Fixed, a Codebase Transformed

For weeks, agents could fall into an endless restate loop — repeating the same opening plan turn after turn while the user waited in vain. This release doesn't patch the symptom: it **eliminates the root cause**, removes the accumulated workarounds, and delivers a faster, more reliable plugin.

## Root Cause, Resolved

OpenCode always appends the current user prompt at the end of the replayed message history. That made every tool-result follow-up look like a "user interrupt" to the proxy — which then **discarded the parked bridge along with the tool results** and re-prompted the model from scratch. Deprived of its tool output, the model restated the same step forever.

Steer detection is now **tail-based and precise**: an interrupt is only recognized when the model opened a tool batch that never received results. Completed tool rounds resume the parked bridge normally — **tool results always reach the model**. The result: a session that once produced 17 identical turns now completes in a single, correct response.

## A Surgical Cleanup: −1,450 Lines of Half-Fixes

Over the past weeks, seven loop detectors, loop-break notes, compaction re-framing, and auto-continue nudges accumulated — one of which was the very bug that caused the loop. All of them are gone. What remains is a **clean, maintainable codebase** that solves problems instead of papering over them.

## No More Frozen Sessions

A stalled model could previously hold an OpenCode step open for **up to 12 minutes**, blocking the session. Now:

- Visible text followed by a pause ends with an honest error in **~90 seconds**.
- Infinite recovery restarts are **capped by real forward progress**.
- Model discovery at startup retries **3×** — transient bridge hiccups no longer disable the provider until restart.

## Proven in Production

- **36 smoke tests pass**, including regression coverage for the exact loop scenario.
- Live verification: the previously-stuck session went from **17 identical turns** to **one clean completion** that used its tool result.
- A test battery across short/long (40KB)/code/Ukrainian/reasoning prompts and parallel/multi-step tool calls: **every request completes, zero loops, zero frozen steps**.

## What This Means for You

- Agents **never loop** on a repeated plan again.
- Tool calls work like clockwork: call → result → next step.
- Predictable, fast responses instead of multi-minute hangs.
- A leaner, more stable plugin under the hood.

This is the most significant release in the plugin's history — upgrade and enjoy the difference.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/otto-assistant/opencode-cursor/compare/v1.4.0...v2.0.0

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/otto-assistant/opencode-cursor/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0

## What's Changed

* fix(proxy): stop AGENTS.md startup thrash + non-compact replan loops by @makeittech in https://github.com/otto-assistant/opencode-cursor/pull/23
* feat: OpenChamber OAuth button + models after login by @makeittech in https://github.com/otto-assistant/opencode-cursor/pull/24
